decisions.reason: The custom in-ear earmold is core hearing-care business made with the firm's existing digital production, so it costs little to keep, though the withdrawal of the similar Product B shows such variants can be consolidated.
The vacuum thermoforming unit is a durable equipment line with its own web page that supports consumable material sales to dental and hearing labs, so it is typically kept for many years.

The orthopedic shoe last is distant from the core business and carries more market risk, but it was only launched in 2024 and has its own page, so management will give it more time to use its digital manufacturing know-how in a new field.
The post-curing unit is an integral part of the firm's 3D-printing workflow for dental and earmold production, which fits its integrated-systems strategy.
